tools.list.api: McpToolProvider.provideTools, as AiServices hands the ChatModel its ToolSpecifications

progress.api: DefaultMcpClient.Builder.progressHandler(McpProgressHandler); the client then sends a progressToken with each tools/call

completion.unsupported: McpClient has no completion/complete method; DefaultMcpClient never sends one

cancellation.mechanism: DefaultMcpClient.Builder.toolExecutionTimeout: when it expires the client sends notifications/cancelled and answers the tool call with toolExecutionTimeoutErrorMessage
cancellation.outcome: returned: There was a timeout executing the tool

caching.api: McpToolProvider.provideTools over DefaultMcpClient.listTools (cacheToolList, default true, until a tools/list_changed notification)
